name: handit
description: Send files directly between any two devices from the browser.
author: Raghav Anand

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.e2e:server: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.wrangler/e2e',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build && npm run dev -w worker -- --persist-to ../.wrangler/e2e --var ALLOWED_ORIGINS:http://localhost:5173
